name: lri-mun-x
description: LRI MUN X — the public conference site, the OC operations hub and the API behind both.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend & npm run dev:website
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/backend && npm run build --workspace apps/frontend && npm run build --workspace apps/website
scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && node scripts/bootstrap-admin.mjs && npm run build --workspace apps/backend && npm run build --workspace apps/frontend && npm run build --workspace apps/website && node scripts/compose-static.mjs
scripts.render-build: npm run build --workspace apps/frontend && npm run build --workspace apps/website && node scripts/compose-static.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/frontend

//allowScripts: npm 12 blocks dependency install scripts unless they are listed here. These four need theirs: Prisma downloads and places its query engine, and esbuild places its platform binary. Without this a clean install — which is exactly what a Vercel build does — produces a tree that cannot generate a client or run Vite. Locally you may not notice, because an older node_modules already has the binaries.
